intro: A Philadelphia rock band led by Adam Granduciel.
story: The War on Drugs, a Philadelphia band led by Adam Granduciel, were an ascending indie-rock act when they played Pickathon in 2012. Slave Ambient, from 2011 on Secretly Canadian, was their second album and the first without co-founder Kurt Vile, and it made year-end lists at Pitchfork, Uncut and Mojo. They returned in 2014, the year of Lost in the Dream. A Deeper Understanding, in 2017, won the Grammy for Best Rock Album.
artist_reel_line: A Deeper Understanding won the Best Rock Album Grammy in 2018.

intro: A Tuareg guitarist from Agadez, Niger.
story: Omara Bombino Moctar is a Tuareg guitarist from Agadez, in northern Niger. Agadez, on Cumbancha in 2011, brought him international attention, and he was introduced to Pickathon audiences in 2012. Nomad, produced by Dan Auerbach for Nonesuch in 2013, was called a landmark in African rock music on NPR. Azel, produced by Dave Longstreth of Dirty Projectors, came in 2016, Deran drew a Grammy nomination in 2019 and Sahel followed in 2023.
artist_reel_line: Deran drew a Grammy nomination in 2019; Sahel followed in 2023.
